Keeping a marriage strong and reducing the risk of divorce often comes down to consistent, open communication and mutual respect. Couples who thrive tend to prioritize listening to each other's needs without judgment and working through conflicts as a team rather than as adversaries. 

It is also incredibly helpful to nurture the friendship at the core of the relationship by spending quality time together, showing appreciation, and maintaining emotional intimacy. Seeking couples counseling before problems become unmanageable can also be a proactive way to strengthen the bond and learn healthy communication tools. Ultimately, it takes a shared commitment from both partners to keep growing together.
